strengths.detail: Allocated <cite id="1">87.2% of expenses to direct programs</cite> in FY2024, beating the 75% sector benchmark [1].
Delivers direct health interventions at an estimated <cite id="6">cost of $25.97 per beneficiary</cite> across large-scale programs [6].

strengths_deep_dive: The Palestine Children's Relief Fund demonstrates exceptional operational efficiency on the ground. In FY2024, it reported <cite id="3">$94,873,840 in revenue</cite> while keeping fundraising costs down to <cite id="1">$0.02 per $1 raised</cite> [1][3]. Its program ratio of <cite id="1">87.2%</cite> exceeds the 75% sector standard, ensuring the vast majority of resources directly reach vulnerable children [1]. The organization's field operations in Gaza provided over <cite id="7">26 million nutrition aid packages in 2024</cite> alongside specialized pediatric surgical care [7].
rich_narrative.summary: The Palestine Children's Relief Fund provides essential medical care and humanitarian aid to children across the Middle East [4]. Founded in <cite id="4">1991</cite>, the organization delivers free medical treatment and urgent aid regardless of political or religious affiliation [4]. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="3">$94,873,840 in total revenue</cite> to fuel wide-ranging health programs [3]. Operations remain financially efficient, with <cite id="1">87.2% of expenses going to programs</cite> and fundraising costs limited to <cite id="1">$0.02 per $1 raised</cite> [1]. During recent crises, the organization mobilized extensive direct aid in Gaza, performing <cite id="7">1,324 emergency surgeries</cite> and delivering over <cite id="7">26 million direct nutrition interventions</cite> in 2024 [7]. It maintains <cite id="2">zakat-eligible status</cite> for funds assisting impoverished and needy families [2]. However, the organization holds <cite id="1">40.9 months of working capital in reserve</cite>, creating a notable delay between donation collection and deployment [1].
